display.purpose: Hero/section titles. Stack: Syne, Manrope (Cyrillic), system-ui.

body.purpose: Leads and paragraphs; local Manrope woff2.

motion.name: cabinet-spin
motion.purpose: Loading busy indicator; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Telegram handoff CTA on Persuade pages.
components.css: .btn.btn--primary { background: #e30613; color: #fff; border-radius: 999px; min-height: 48px; padding: 0.85rem 1.35rem; font-family: Syne, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; }

components.name: Ghost Button
components.description: Secondary ghost actions (cabinet CTA currently paused on the public site).
components.css: .btn.btn--ghost { background: transparent; color: #0a0a0a; border: 2px solid #0a0a0a; border-radius: 999px; min-height: 44px; }

components.name: Feature Card
components.css: .feature-card { background: #fbf8f5; border: 1px solid rgba(10,10,10,0.08); border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.15rem 1.2rem; }

components.name: Nav Toggle
components.description: Mobile menu control at ≤980px when html.js-nav is set.
components.css: .nav-toggle { min-height: 44px; min-width: 44px; border: 1px solid #0a0a0a; border-radius: 5px; background: transparent; font-family: Syne, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 700; }

narrative.overview: Bright, direct handoff into Telegram. Persuade pages lead with brand red and one CTA; Operate pages keep the palette but drop marketing density. Fonts are self-hosted (Manrope/Syne woff2).
keyCharacteristics: Red as signal; ink for body

rules.name: The Fill vs Ink Rule
rules.body: Use brand red for fills; red-ink for text/links on light backgrounds.

rules.name: The One Primary Action Rule
rules.body: One red Telegram CTA on Persuade pages; cabinet/ghost stay secondary.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Ambient offset shadows only; no decorative glow halos.

dos: Do lead Persuade pages with MAYAG Fit and one Telegram CTA.
Do keep Operate pages quieter and denser.
Do prefer colon/period over em-dash in body copy.
donts: Don't invent a second accent palette or dark-mode-first marketing look.
Don't put badges or stats strips on hero media.
Don't recreate the full training product on the website.
